string.text: Good! You can go, but you better have some really important business with the Barkeep, you hear? And be careful - there's lots of anomalies ahead.
Well, you can't go through to the bar then.
Say "hi" for the Barkeep from me when you see him. Oh, and don't forget - there are lots of anomalies on the way, so be careful.
Excellent, Marked One, you really helped us out there. I say that's payment enough for your pass. Go on to the Bar.
You're rubbish, Marked One. Totally useless! Don't expect gratitude - there's nothing to thank you for!
